Tokyo Coffee Spots to visit:
1. Koffee Mameya (Omotesando): Quiet tasting room where baristas consult on roast level and origin beans. Reserve morning slot.
2. Fuglen Tokyo (Yoyogi/Shibuya): Norwegian light roast espresso by day, craft cocktail lounge after 7:00 PM.
3. Glitch Coffee & Roasters (Jinbocho): Specializes in exotic anaerobic and yeast-inoculated single origin pour-overs served in wine glasses.
4. Chatei Hatou (Shibuya): Historic kissaten, traditional nel drip filter, Charcoal-roasted aged Sumatran beans.
